card.title: Automated premium experiences
card.excerpt: A WhatsApp bot that serves, guides and chats with Stella Artois customers around the clock, with an experience that matches the brand.

paragraphs: Stella Artois wanted support worthy of its premium brand — always available and without the friction of traditional channels.
We built a digital coworker on WhatsApp that automates interactions: it answers questions, guides experiences and keeps a refined conversation with every customer, around the clock.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: Deliver premium, always-on support without overwhelming the team or depending on business hours.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: A conversational WhatsApp bot that automates support and guides premium experiences, available 24/7.

result.label: Result
result.text: A brand that serves every customer in real time, with a consistent experience at any hour.
